posts.title: November 1st: Western Canada keeps its clocks. Is your software ready?

posts.title: A simple HTTPS proxy with interception in Python
posts.description: This is a followup of my previous article How an HTTP/HTTPS Proxy Work where I explained how a basic HTTP proxy works. In this article, I will explain how to implement a simple HTTPS proxy with interception in Python using asyncio and the ssl module. No third-party libraries are required.
